# PropelusAI

> PropelusAI is a global AI company that builds websites, CRM systems, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, and subscription based AI products for businesses worldwide.

## Company Information

- Website: https://www.propelusai.com
- Email: support@propelusai.com
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona, USA
- Engineering Offices: Surat, Gujarat, India and Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- US Entity: BETH and friends LLC
- India Entity: RBSS Ventures (Propelus by RBSS), GSTIN: 19ABMFR6144D1ZZ
- Industries Served: SaaS, fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, manufacturing, consulting, education, logistics, media, retail, and professional services
- Support Hours: 9:00 AM to 12:00 AM IST (GMT+5:30), Monday through Friday

## AI Products (Monthly Subscriptions)

PropelusAI offers 21 subscription based AI products:

1. AI Driven LinkedIn Advertising — managed monthly LinkedIn ads with predictive targeting and conversion tracking
2. LinkedIn Content Engine — 20 AI assisted posts per month to grow authority and visibility
3. AI Assisted Cold Calling and Prospect Prioritization — human plus AI calling with priority based prospect lists
4. AI Based Meta and Google Advertising — managed Meta and Google campaigns with AI creative optimization
5. AI Powered CRM, Analytics and Lead Management — hosted CRM with predictive lead scoring and pipeline analytics
6. AI Powered Content Creation — platform specific content with SEO driven workflows
7. LinkedIn Thought Leadership Content Program — 20 posts plus 4 articles per month for personal branding
8. Multi Platform Content Calendar Management — 40 to 60 social media posts across all platforms
9. WhatsApp Business Messaging and Automation — automated broadcast campaigns and chatbot flows
10. AI Based Instagram and Facebook Advertising — full funnel Meta ads with AI audience targeting
11. AI Based LinkedIn Targeting and Lead Segmentation — precision prospecting from millions of LinkedIn profiles
12. AI Based Lead Generation and Management — multi channel lead capture with AI scoring and routing
13. Social Media Reels and Short Form Video Production — 8 to 12 platform optimized videos per month
14. AI Enhanced Copywriting and Messaging Strategy — landing pages, emails, ads with A/B testing
15. Funnel Tracking and CRO Analytics — conversion rate optimization dashboards and reporting
16. AI Powered Email Marketing and Automation — email campaigns with AI personalization and segmentation
17. Performance Dashboard Subscription — real time business analytics across all channels
18. AI Powered Sales Enablement Suite — sales team tools, AI coaching, and pipeline intelligence
19. AI Brand Monitoring and Reputation Management — brand tracking, sentiment analysis, and alerts
20. AI Podcast Production and Distribution — end to end podcast management and distribution
21. AI Event Marketing and Webinar Management — event promotion, registration, and follow up automation

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is the difference between PropelusAI Products and Services?
A: Services are one time upfront engagements like website development or CRM builds. Products are subscription based with recurring monthly access like LinkedIn advertising or content creation.

Q: Which industries does PropelusAI work with?
A: PropelusAI works with all industries including SaaS, fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, manufacturing, consulting, education, logistics, and professional services.

Q: Does PropelusAI work globally?
A: Yes. PropelusAI supports clients globally with offices in Phoenix Arizona USA, Surat India, and Kolkata India.

Q: How long does a website project take?
A: Most AI powered websites take 2 to 4 weeks depending on the number of pages and complexity.

Q: How long does a mobile app take?
A: Typical mobile app builds take 8 to 12 weeks plus 2 weeks for app store approvals.

Q: How do subscription products work?
A: Each product is a monthly or quarterly recurring plan that includes ongoing optimization, analytics, reporting, and dedicated support. Plans can be adjusted at the end of each billing cycle.

Q: Does PropelusAI manage LinkedIn and Meta ads fully?
A: Yes. PropelusAI handles creative, targeting, optimization, reporting, testing, automation, and funnel tracking. Ad spend is billed directly to the client ad platform.

Q: What compliance frameworks does PropelusAI support for cybersecurity?
A: PropelusAI supports NIST, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 compliance requirements.
